verdict.rationale: Netlify is a hosting platform with managed databases, Blobs storage and serverless functions, so choosing a data region or residency is a fair question for it. However, no evidence item documents any region or residency selection. The pack only mentions global CDN deployment and a third-party Turso edge-database integration, neither of which is a Netlify region-choice capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
